note: Rustic campground on the southeast corner of 104-acre Buffalo Lake near Woodruff, with a mowed grassy swimming beach and a boat landing inside the campground. Pads are uneven; reviewers say take care with rigs over about 30 ft. County Highway J has bike lanes to St. Germain and Woodruff. --Claude
summary: NHAL rustic page and the DNR campground brochure/map read; GoingToCamp unread (refuses). 52 sites (5 walk-to/tent-only), no electricity, vault toilets, four hand pumps, reservation required. Open April 30 to Columbus Day. Pin is inside the loops. Waterfront stays not waterfront, with a lakeview possibility for the west-loop sites flagged.
flags: WATERFRONT: kept not waterfront (default down), but the stored evidence ('shore ~100 m west behind unbroken trees') overstates the distance. On Esri imagery the west loop road runs about 50-55 m from the shore, and the double sites 2021-2024 sit just north and east of the open mowed beach lawn (about 45.8775,-89.5652), roughly 25-50 m from the water but behind a clump of pines; the pads can't be resolved under the canopy. Sites 2013-2020, also on the west side of that road, are 40-60 m from the shore through pines. The reviewer could consider lakeview for 2021-2024 (nightly reservable double sites). Not upgraded: open ground to the water can't be shown.

SEASON (manual, not overwritten): the DNR says 'open April 30-Columbus Day'. Stored 04-30..10-14 (approx.); Columbus Day is Oct 12 in 2026 and Oct 11 in 2027, so the close should read 10-12 (2026) / 10-11 (2027).
FACILITIES: the property page says three hand pumps, but the 2025 brochure says four. The note no longer gives a count.
PIN: 45.87784,-89.56372 is inside the campground loops (the DNR GPS point N45 52.581 W89 33.738 = 45.87635,-89.56230 is the entrance on Buffalo Lake Road). Fine.
UNCONFIRMED: stored fees ($19, GoingToCamp 2026-10-10) and any length limit are on wisconsin.goingtocamp.com (refuses, not retried). The rustic page and brochure give no length limit.

PHONE: 715-356-3668 (Clear Lake Visitor Station) confirmed by the brochure; Crystal Lake Visitor Station 715-542-3923 is the alternative. WEBSITE: the NHAL rustic page is current; keep the goingtocamp link.
